channel.title: Blow Your Mind
channel.desc: Dr Chris and Dr Xand van Tulleken track down the most awesome, incredible things in the universe! This time it's all about space. In this episode, they find out about meteoric meteorites, and what happens when they land on Earth. Their space expert friends are on a mission to find the biggest crater on the planet and they discover that something amazing happened when a massive planet crashed into Earth a long, long time ago.
